voiceover_script.text: Welcome to the future of healthcare, where AI is revolutionizing the way we diagnose and treat diseases.
AI is being used in various ways to improve healthcare outcomes, from diagnosis to treatment.
However, there are also challenges associated with the use of AI in healthcare.
Patients and healthcare professionals are also concerned about the impact of AI on their jobs.
Experts believe that AI has the potential to improve healthcare outcomes, but it requires careful consideration of its limitations and challenges.

In conclusion, AI has the potential to transform healthcare, but it requires careful consideration of its limitations and challenges.
